sources.title: A Voting Classifier Approach to Bloom's Taxonomy: Integrating BERT and ...
sources.snippet: This research proposes a hybrid model combining Discriminative AI with Generative AI using a voting classifier. This ensemble integrates an advanced Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) model with Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT). For this reason, we finetuned two models based on GPT architecture.
